text:
B: Alright, mate! Hiya. Can you hear me?
A: Yeah, I can hear you. Darren.
B: Rhys. Nice one. Sorry if I look rough, I was up half four for work.
A: You're alright. What is it you do?
B: Supermarket, on the shelves. Replenishment. You?
A: Gas engineer. Boilers, mostly. Halesowen.
B: Oh, proper trade, that. Fair play. My dad's a van driver for a builders' merchant, he's always on about the gas lads coming in.
A: Which one?
B: Sorry?
A: Which merchant?
B: Oh, erm, I don't know the name, sorry, it's in Caerphilly. Big yellow sign. That's not helpful, is it.
A: Ha. Not really.
B: I keep thinking about doing a trade, honestly. Plastering, maybe. Or something. I sort of fell off college, the BTEC, I never finished it.
A: How old are you?
B: Twenty-four.
A: You've got time. I've had lads start their apprenticeship at twenty-five, twenty-six. Thing is, you've got to turn up. That's half of it. Turn up on time, do it properly, clean up after yourself. The ones that don't last, it's never because they can't do it, it's because they're late and they're on their phone.
B: Yeah. Yeah, no, that's fair. That's, er, that's me a bit, to be honest. I've had a word about my phone.
A: Well. There you go, then.
B: Ha, cheers! You sound like my dad now.
A: I've got a fifteen and a twelve-year-old, I get a lot of practice.
B: Do you go away much, like holidays?
A: Same place every summer. Caravan park near Tenby.
B: No way! Tenby! We used to go Tenby every year when I was a kid. Caravan, the lot.
A: Which park?
B: Erm, one with a big pool with a slide. And a club with bingo.
A: That's most of them, mate.
B: Ha, yeah, true. I lost at crazy golf to my sister there. Still not over it.
A: We do the beach in the morning, walk the dog on the cliffs, chippy at night. Can't beat it. Kids moan they want abroad, but they're fine once they're there.
B: Tidy. What dog you got?
A: Cocker spaniel. Bonnie. Rolls in everything she finds.
B: Ours is a Jack Russell, Bryn. He's old now, he just sleeps on my mam's feet. Do you do football?
A: West Brom.
B: Cardiff. We've had a few against yous lot.
A: We have. Can't remember many good ones.
B: Me neither, mate, me neither. I play five-a-side, we got battered seven-two Wednesday.
A: Used to play Sunday league. Knees gave up.
B: Mine'll give up before I'm thirty, the way I play. So if I did a trade, like, would you say gas or—
